items.title: Rick Margitza interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 22, 2024
items.q: And he called me and said, “Kenny just left, we need you.” And the first gig I played was in Stockholm.

ctx.x: Did you have rehearsals for that, was it six or seven weeks that you played with them — at least from what I read — and were there rehearsals before that? Because he’s not calling tunes like “Green Dolphin Street.”

No there wasn’t. And I can tell you quickly the story of how I got the gig is I was living in New Orleans at the time and my friend from high school and college, his name is Matt Pearson who is a producer now, he was working as an intern at Blue Note. And he said, “Put together a demo tape because I can get it to Bruce Lundvall who is the president of Blue Note, and we might be able to do a record together. So I sent a tape and he played it for Bruce and Bruce said yeah, let’s do the record with him. But Matt…
